title: ZeroSDR
summary: ZeroSDR turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket SDR receiver.
description:
Features
- Real-time spectrum and waterfall on the 320×170 display
- FM / NFM / AM / USB / LSB audio with squelch, AGC and de-emphasis
- Wideband swept spectrum page (custom range, pan/zoom, max hold)
- RFI survey: compare HF noise with equipment on/off (10m–80m)
- ADSB: nearest-first list, PFD detail view and map radar
- AIS: list, map with CPA guard ring, porthole ship dossier, NMEA UDP output
- ACARS: aircraft message list and wrapped detail view
- Fn+P screenshot on every page; Fn+D/Fn+S system volume
- Runs as a normal user; no root, no background service

Requirements

- RTL-SDR USB dongle (tested with RTL-SDR Blog V4)
- VHF/UHF antenna for SDR and AIS; 1090 MHz antenna for ADSB
